_README: Artist display names for CJK artists, Simplified (Charlie's choice).
Keys are the names as YouTube CREDITS them — the same artist appears under
several forms ('A Mei', 'Chang Hui Mei', 'aMEI' are all 张惠妹), so every
variant seen in the library gets its own key.
Generated by resolving each credit against YouTube's artist search, then
curated by hand; entries YouTube has no Han form for (JJ Lin, Leehom Wang)
were filled in manually. Multi-artist credits are deliberately absent —
those are rewritten per-artist at render time.
Add a name here rather than teaching the resolver another special case.

'titles' overrides a SONG title, keyed by videoId so it can never hit the wrong track. Only for titles YouTube gives as romanized pinyin or as a translation — songs genuinely titled in English (David Tao's 'Angel', G.E.M.'s 'HELL', aMEI's 'BAD BOY') are left alone.

romanizedPreferred._note: Artists billed under their romanized name; shown as-is even though a Han form exists.
